items.name: Set.ncard_range_of_injective
items.type: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {f : α → β} (hf : Function.Injective f) : (Set.range f).ncard = Nat.card α

items.name: Set.ncard_image_of_injective
items.type: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {f : α → β} (s : Set α) (H : Function.Injective f) : (f '' s).ncard = s.ncard

items.name: Set.ncard_preimage_of_injective_subset_range
items.type: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {f : α → β} {s : Set β} (H : Function.Injective f) (hs : s ⊆ Set.range f) : (f ⁻¹' s).ncard = s.ncard
